== Introduction

Use the Admin REST API `_user` and `_role` endpoints to provision and manage {sgw} users through persistent configuration changes.

This page introduces the <<put_db-_role-name,Create or Update a Role>> and <<put_db-_user-name,Create or Update a User>> endpoints for convenience -- see {rest-api-admin--xref--database-security} for a full description of the endpoints available.

It also includes a JSON-data model, you can use to build your request bodies. See: <<lbl-schema>>

[#lbl-upsert-role]
== Create or Update a Role


----
PUT /{db}/_role/{name}
----

include::partial$static_restapi/admin/index.adoc[tags=put_db-_role-name-description,leveloffset=-2]

For detailed parameters and response information, see: {rest-api-admin-role-post--xref}

=== Example using Named collections



====

[{tabs}]
=====



Curl::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

curl --location --request PUT 'http://127.0.0.1:4985/travel25/_role/newrole' \ // <.>
--header 'Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk' \ // <.>
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "name": "newrole",
    "collection_access": {
      "scopename": {
          "collectionname": {
               "admin_channels": ["newrolechannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}'

----

--

HTTP::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

PUT /travel25/_role/newrole HTTP/1.1 // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985
Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk // <.>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 134

{
    "name": "newrole",
    "collection_access": {
      "scopename": {
          "collectionname": {
               "admin_channels": ["newrolechannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}

----

--

=====

<.> Add role `newrole` to the `travel25` database and the `scopename` scope and `collectionname` collection
<.> Note we are using Basic Auth to authenticate to an existing RBAC user

====

=== Example using Default collections

====

[{tabs}]
=====

Curl::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

curl --location --request PUT 'http://127.0.0.1:4985/travel25/_role/newrole' \ // <.>
--header 'Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk' \ // <.>
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "name": "newrole",
    "collection_access": {
      "_default": {
          "_default": {
               "admin_channels": ["newrolechannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}'

----

--

HTTP::
+
--

[source, bash]
----

PUT /travel25/_role/newrole HTTP/1.1 // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985
Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk // <.>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 132

{
    "name": "newrole",
    "collection_access": {
      "_default": {
          "_default": {
               "admin_channels": ["newrolechannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}

----

--

=====

<.> Add role `newrole` to the `travel25` database using the `_default` scope and collection
<.> Note we are using Basic Auth to authenticate to an existing RBAC user

====

For complete role management operations, see: {rest-api-admin-role-post--xref}[Role management API Reference]


[#lbl-upsert-user]
== Create or Update a User

----
PUT /{db}/_user/{username} // <.>
----

<.> where `{db}` is the Sync Gateway database and `{username}` is the name for the new user

include::partial$static_restapi/admin/index.adoc[tags=put_db-_user-name-description,leveloffset=-3]

For detailed parameters and response information, see: {rest-api-admin-user-post--xref}[Create User] or {rest-api-admin-user-put--xref}[Update User]

=== Example using Named collections

====

[{tabs}]
=====

Curl::
+
--

[source, bash]
----
curl --location --request PUT 'http://127.0.0.1:4985/travel25/_user/newuser' \ // <.>
--header 'Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "name": "newuser",
    "password": "pass",
    "collection_access": {
      "scopename": {
          "collectionname": {
               "admin_channels": ["newuserchannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}'

----

--

HTTP::
+
--
[source, bash]
----

PUT /travel25/_user/newuser HTTP/1.1 // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985
Authorization: Basic c3luY19nYXRld2F5OnBhc3N3b3Jk
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 154

{
    "name": "newuser",
    "password": "pass",
    "collection_access": {
      "scopename": {
          "collectionname": {
               "admin_channels": ["newuserchannel"]
          }
      }
   }
}

----
--

=====

<.> Add user `newuser` to the `travel25` database with access to `scopename.collectionname`

====

PUT /travel25/_user/newuser HTTP/1.1 // <.>
Host: 127.0.0.1:4985

{

== Schema

This section shows Sync Gateway's database security configuration settings in schema format for convenience in constructing JSON models for use in the Admin REST API.

The configuration settings described here are provisioned through the Admin REST API -- see as shown in {rest-api-admin--xref--database-security}.
